message: Mismatches (BLAST column) is Desemparejamientos, not Discordancias or Desapareamientos (round 1, D-05).
Write the Latin term locus tag; etiqueta de locus is not found in Spanish writing (glossary Locus tag).

Word on the STYLE 6.1 Never list: write archivo for fichero, the device name or nothing for ordenador / computadora, guardar for salvar, quitar for remover, restablecer for resetear, configurar for setear, comprobar for chequear, hacer clic for clicar / cliquear / pinchar / pulsar, similitud, número de acceso, calificador, cadena for hebra, orgánulo, the glossary term for rasgo, tomar for coger.
Reset is Restablecer and Add is Agregar (glossary); reiniciar / añadir may still fit another sense (restart the browser).
vale is on the STYLE 6.1 Never list (Accept is Aceptar); keep it only as the verb valer.
English word that STYLE 6.1 never keeps: pista, característica, ranura, preajuste, carril, ventana emergente, predeterminado, restablecer.
Feature is característica, never función or elemento (glossary Feature); keep these only for their own meaning.
Never registro/secuencia lineal (a topology) or escala lineal (linear vs logarithmic): write diagrama lineal or the glossary form (glossary Linear).
On axis is En el eje; Sobre el eje reads as above (glossary On axis).
Pin is Fijar; anclar would echo ancla (Anchor) (glossary Pin).
Organelle is orgánulo; organelo is not used (glossary Organelle).
Arrow shaft is the glossary form, not astil (archery jargon).
Exact reference is Característica de referencia, not referencia exacta (glossary).
The base-pair unit is bp, never pb (glossary bp).
